name: TeamStarWolf - Other state-linked threat actors
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping and not an attribution claim. The 154 Enterprise techniques ATT&CK v20.0 links to the 20 groups in case-studies/THREAT_ACTORS_OTHER_STATES.md, the state-linked tier outside China, Russia, Iran, North Korea and the United States: 14 groups whose ATT&CK text names or suspects a state, a state body, a region or a Hamas affiliation, or calls them likely state-sponsored, plus 6 that ATT&CK leaves stateless and the study places in that tier from vendor primaries or ATT&CK overlap notes. Score is the number of those 20 groups linked to the technique (1 to 13). Comments name the groups, the study's source numbers and, where a vendor or government primary describes the technique, the dated report.

legendItems.label: 1: linked by ATT&CK v20.0 to one of the study's 20 groups
7: linked to seven of the 20 groups
13: linked to thirteen of the 20 groups (the most for any technique, T1204.002 Malicious File)

metadata.name: score
metadata.value: Number of the study's 20 groups that ATT&CK v20.0 links to the technique; breadth across the tier, not severity, and not an attribution claim.

metadata.name: attack_version
metadata.value: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise v20.0: technique IDs and tactics normalized to data/attack/technique_profiles.jsonl by scripts/build_navigator_layers.py
